description: This file manages bootstrap files for an agent, including loading, filtering, sanitizing, and resolving bootstrap context files for runtime execution.

methods.name: makeBootstrapWarn
methods.description: Creates a warning function that prepends session label to messages.

methods.name: sanitizeBootstrapFiles
methods.description: Sanitizes bootstrap files by trimming their path and filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: applyContextModeFilter
methods.description: Filters bootstrap files based on the context mode and run kind.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapFilesForRun
methods.description: Loads, filters, applies hooks, and sanitizes bootstrap files for a given run.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapContextForRun
methods.description: Resolves bootstrap files and context files for a runtime session.
